items.description: The blueprint-driven module views (task 2.4) — ModuleView (the ClickUp-style container) plus its List / Kanban / Hybrid bodies, the pipeline TaskDetail, the dashboard module type’s DashboardView widget grid, the inbox module type’s InboxView date-grouped notification feed, and the metadata-driven ViewTypePicker "Select Preferred View" takeover behind the view-tab strip’s "+" (DRAFT — first-adopter exemplars, API not yet settled). All render from a v5-composer blueprint; Kanban runs on pragmatic-drag-and-drop (v5-tier), saved views persist via an injected adapter. See docs/BOUNDARIES.md § The patterns tier.
